title: Capsule scene document
description: A scene document: the settings a scene starts with and every entity and tile map it places.

$schema.description: The URL of this file's JSON Schema, which gives an editor completion and hover. The build ignores its value.

formatVersion.description: The document format's version, which must be one this build supports.

baseScene.description: The key of an abstract Scene subclass. The composed scene derives from it. Absent composes a plain Scene.

camera.description: The key of a concrete Camera subclass with a parameterless constructor, which the scene installs. Absent leaves the scene's default camera in place.

size.description: The scene's extent as [w, h], both finite and greater than zero. Absent keeps the extent of the document's tile maps.

scrollCenter.description: The camera centre at which every layer sits as authored, as [x, y]. Absent leaves each camera its own.

clearColor.description: The colour the scene clears to, as "#rrggbb" or as "#rrggbbaa" with an ff alpha.

ambient.description: The scene's ambient light colour, as "#rrggbb" or as "#rrggbbaa" with an ff alpha.

sampling.description: How the scene's textures are sampled. Absent keeps the game's setting.

properties.description: The scene's properties. Each key sets the member the composing scene class marks [Authorable].

entities.description: Every entry the scene places, in document order. Write an empty list for a scene with nothing in it.

id.description: The entry's id: positive, unique in the document and lower than nextEntityId.

type.description: The spawn type: the key of the entity class the entry composes, or "tile-map" for terrain.

x.description: The entry's x position. A tile-map entry is anchored at 0.

y.description: The entry's y position. A tile-map entry is anchored at 0.

rotation.description: The turn in degrees, clockwise on screen. Absent is 0. A tile-map entry refuses it.

scale.description: The raw authored factor as [x, y], both finite and greater than zero. Absent is identity. A tile-map entry refuses it.

zIndex.description: The entry's draw band. On a tile-map entry it applies to the composed map.

scrollFactor.description: How far the entry moves with the camera, as [x, y], both finite. On a tile-map entry it applies to the composed map.

properties.description: The entry's properties. A tile-map entry holds its grid here. A game entity's keys set the members its class marks [Authorable].
A tile map's grid: its tile size, its extent in tiles, the texture it draws from, its palette and its tiles.

tileSize.description: The side of one square tile in pixels.

texture.description: The key of the texture every drawn tile is cut from, extension included, with forward slashes and no empty, "." or ".." segment. Absent on a grid that draws nothing.

columns.description: How many cells wide the texture is. Required with texture, and absent without one.

tileTypes.description: The palette every tile indexes. Index 0 is "empty", carrying nothing but its name.

name.description: The tile type's name, unique within the palette.

type.description: The key of the TileType subclass the entry composes. Absent composes a plain TileType.

cell.description: Which cell of the texture a tile of this type draws, counted across a row of columns then down from cell 0. Absent is a semantic tile: queryable, may collide, draws nothing.

layer.description: The collision layer every tile of this type is on, one name the game owns. Absent is decoration.

shape.description: The convex polygon the tile collides as: three or four [x, y] points in pixels from the tile's top-left corner with Y down, each within [0, tileSize]. Absent is the whole tile.

oneWay.description: True for a tile that blocks only a body coming down onto it from above.

solidSides.description: True for a oneWay tile that also blocks from the sides and passes a body only from below.

properties.description: The entry's properties. Each key sets the member its TileType subclass marks [Authorable].

tiles.description: The width x height palette indices, row by row from the top-left tile.

transforms.description: How each tile's drawing and collision shape is mirrored or turned, in the shape of tiles. 1 mirrors it left to right, 2 top to bottom and 4 swaps its axes before either, and the sum combines them. Absent is all 0.

nextEntityId.description: The next id to hand out, greater than every entry's id. Deleted ids are not reused.

source.description: What a derived document came from. Its presence marks a derived file, and an authoring source omits it.

tool.description: The tool that derived the document.

path.description: The source's relative path, with forward slashes.

hash.description: The SHA-256 of the source closure, as 64 lowercase hex characters.
